panels.title: Seconds since last event, per source
panels.description: The AU-5 source-silence signal. Live sources should stay green; AWS sources read as ancient until AWS ingestion goes live (their alert rules ship paused).

targets.rawSql: SELECT source, last_event, lag_seconds FROM (SELECT 'linux_syslog' AS source, max(event_time) AS last_event, toUInt64(now()) - toUInt64(coalesce(max(event_time), toDateTime(0))) AS lag_seconds FROM siem.linux_syslog UNION ALL SELECT 'windows_events', max(event_time), toUInt64(now()) - toUInt64(coalesce(max(event_time), toDateTime(0))) FROM siem.windows_events UNION ALL SELECT 'k8s_logs', max(event_time), toUInt64(now()) - toUInt64(coalesce(max(event_time), toDateTime(0))) FROM siem.k8s_logs UNION ALL SELECT 'cloudtrail', max(event_time), toUInt64(now()) - toUInt64(coalesce(max(event_time), toDateTime(0))) FROM siem.cloudtrail UNION ALL SELECT 'guardduty', max(event_time), toUInt64(now()) - toUInt64(coalesce(max(event_time), toDateTime(0))) FROM siem.guardduty UNION ALL SELECT 'vpc_flow', max(event_time), toUInt64(now()) - toUInt64(coalesce(max(event_time), toDateTime(0))) FROM siem.vpc_flow UNION ALL SELECT 's3_access', max(event_time), toUInt64(now()) - toUInt64(coalesce(max(event_time), toDateTime(0))) FROM siem.s3_access) ORDER BY lag_seconds ASC

panels.title: Events ingested per 10 minutes, by source
panels.description: Ingest rate for the live sources. A line dropping to zero while its host is active = investigate.

targets.rawSql: SELECT t, source, c FROM (SELECT toStartOfInterval(event_time, INTERVAL 10 minute) AS t, 'linux_syslog' AS source, count() AS c FROM siem.linux_syslog WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time) GROUP BY t UNION ALL SELECT toStartOfInterval(event_time, INTERVAL 10 minute), 'windows_events', count() FROM siem.windows_events WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time) GROUP BY 1 UNION ALL SELECT toStartOfInterval(event_time, INTERVAL 10 minute), 'k8s_logs', count() FROM siem.k8s_logs WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time) GROUP BY 1 UNION ALL SELECT toStartOfInterval(event_time, INTERVAL 10 minute), 'cloudtrail', count() FROM siem.cloudtrail WHERE $__timeFilter(event_time) GROUP BY 1) ORDER BY t
